visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged Asian man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a crisp white button-down shirt, stands against a studio backdrop with a bookshelf and a warm vertical light bar. He speaks with high energy, using expressive hand gestures and facial expressions. Large yellow captions are visible at the top of the frame. (2) A transition leads to a 3D animation of a highway where stylized cars travel. Green icons representing 5G signals and location pins float above the vehicles. The environment is bright and flat-styled with green grass and a blue sky. (3) The man returns to the frame, followed by a series of quick meme-style cuts, including a man with a confused expression. Then, real-world testing footage shows a car equipped with sensors performing an AEB automatic braking test against a trailer on a gray tarmac track. (4) A digital animation of a busy city intersection appears from a top-down perspective. Cars are connected by pulsing green data lines. Text labels like 'V2V' and 'V2X' flash periodically. The lighting in the studio shots is bright and professional, while animations use vivid, high-saturation colors. (5) Footage shows a car's roof-mounted LIDAR sensor spinning rapidly. This is followed by a nighttime animation showing sensor beams scanning a street. Quick-cut memes of a bicycle crash and a basketball player laughing are interspersed with the technical presentation. (6) Diagrams illustrate communication between two cars, one blue and one purple, using radio wave icons to show data transfer. The man is then shown holding a small toy car to demonstrate collision paths. (7) Screenshots of official notices and technical platforms are displayed, followed by an animation of 'Hacker' cars. The final phase shows people at an airport customs counter and a luggage-scanning animation with 'Super X-Ray' text, concluding with the man giving a thumbs-up and pointing downwards.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Statement -> Technical Breakdown -> Counter-argument -> Solution/Collaboration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the audience on the limitations of standalone AI-vision for autonomous vehicles and advocate for the integration of V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) communication technology. The video specifically promotes a security verification platform developed by CECI and NTUST to prevent signal hacking.
